# Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

#getting protein names
var_names <- read_csv(here("data", "biomarker-raw.csv"), 
                     col_names = F, 
                     n_max = 2, 
                     col_select = -(1:2)) |>
  t() |>
  as_tibble() |>
  rename(name = V1, 
         abbreviation = V2) |>
  na.omit()

#load in data
biomarker_raw <- read_csv(here("data", "biomarker-raw.csv"),
                          skip = 2,
                          col_select = -2L,
                          col_names = c("group",
                                        "empty",
                                        pull(var_names, abbreviation),
                                        "ados"),
                          na = c("-", "")) |>
  filter(!is.na(group)) |>
  select(group, ados, everything())


```

# Distributions of Raw Values

```{r}
#picking 4 random proteins
set.seed(2026)

protein_cols <- setdiff(names(biomarker_raw), c("group","ados"))
chosen <- sample(protein_cols, 4)

hist_data <- biomarker_raw |>
  select(all_of(chosen)) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "protein", values_to = "raw") |>
  mutate(log10 = log10(raw)) |>
  pivot_longer(c(raw, log10), names_to = "scale", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(scale = factor(scale, levels = c("raw", "log10")))

ggplot(hist_data, aes(x = value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 25, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  facet_wrap(vars(protein, scale), scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  labs(x = "protein level", y = "count",
       title = "raw vs. log10 protein levels")

```
